about: Everything the remake invented that Glitch did not have, in one place for review (root issue R16, Austin 2026-11-17). kind: behaviour | visual | data | placement | UI | content. status: kept (Austin ruled to keep; ruling says when and where) | proposed (a lane made it, no ruling yet) | under-review (flagged for Austin: looks like inventions he has dropped) | dropped (ruled out and gone; kept as precedent). where: file and symbol. rows: coverage register rows. family: the data family whose members must equal `members` (tools/inventions/scan.mjs FAMILIES). Entries named ours-<system> were seeded from the code's own "ours" marks, one per system; split or retitle them as they are reviewed. tools/inventions/markers.json says which entry claims each marker in the code; tests/inventions-register.test.js fails on a new unclaimed one. compare / noCompare (Austin 2026-11-25, #699, G1308): every kept visual entry either names where its Tiny Speck original is shown beside ours on /restoration/ (compare: an entry id of tools/made-art/compare.json, the Our additions section, or "made" for the Made for Groddle band) or says in noCompare why there is no original to show (lost art, a size or a mirror of Tiny Speck's own drawing, a colour that is not a picture). A new kept visual addition lands with its compare entry: add it to tools/made-art/compare.json (pictures by tools/made-art/compare-art.mjs), then node tools/made-art/build-data.mjs; tools/inventions/scan.mjs --check and tests/inventions-register.test.js fail until one of the two is there.

entries.title: Happy New Ur (Dec 31): a countdown, sparkles and fireworks at all six Groddle midnights, the one nearest 1 PM Pacific the big one with a party on Unnu Slight (confetti, a warm glow on the stone dragon, Goodnight Groddle), a "HAPPY NEW UR!" New Day screen, one free trip to the party, Global notices at 24 h, 1 h and 10 min, synced online by the server
entries.why: Austin's picks 2026-11-23 (G1195, research/seasonal/new-year-plan.md). Glitch's own New Year was two seconds of the Sparkle Powder burst for everyone online at midnight Pacific 2011, with players gathered at Unnu Slight: matched (one moment for the world, the sparkle Ur-wide, the party street). Ours: the moment is a Groddle midnight (six on Dec 31 on Ur's clock, all derived from the game clock), the 10-minute HUD countdown and the 10..4 numbers, the fireworks (Tiny Speck's loneliness-party overlays) and the 321 overlay at that moment, the New Day screen's title and lines, the party dressing and its free teleport, the Global lines, the season window Dec 26 to Jan 3 for later stock.

entries.title: Happy New Ur's party pieces: the Midnight Sparkly keepsake (one a year) and the badge Rang In the New Ur for a midnight seen (online on the server's word), the Confetti Popper (Toy Vendor, or a Tinkertool with Paper, a Sparkly and an Element for its colour; a bang and a confetti burst the street sees, everyone near jumps), Bubbly (Cocktail Shaker: grapes and a Tiny Bubble) and its Toast, Sparkly Batterflies from the big midnight to the end of January 1, party hats on street Chickens on December 31 and January 1

Glitch had no New Year item, quest or badge. Glitch habits followed: the Glitchmas Cracker (seasonal Toy Vendor stock, single use, GLITCHMAS_CRACKER bang, the burst seen by the street), Sno Cones taking their colour from an Element, include/drink.js drinks, Pot Luck Day's costume system with Tiny Speck's CC0 party_hat. Ours: every rule, number and word; the Batterflies run to the end of January 1 rather than the plan's one Groddle day; the popper and badge centre icons are placeholders until Grok Bot's pack (research/art-briefs/new-ur-2026-11-23).

entries.title: Mining swings at 0.3 of Glitch's time (6, 4.2, 3 and 2.4 s for Mining I to IV)
entries.why: Players pushed back on Glitch's 20/14/10/8 s swings once v0.41.0 restored them (G758, #330). A compromise at about a third, ranks keeping Glitch's proportions; Manic Mining still applies on top, and energy, wear, xp and yield per swing stay Glitch's (catalog_skill_packages.js mining, mining_fancypick). One shared factor so other timed systems can take it later. A mined-out rock reforms in 144 s, Glitch's 8 min (include/mining.js 422) at 0.3 (PACED_WAITS rock_respawn), read by solo mining, home rocks, help crews, the realtime server and the site (#521; it was 45 s, so two rocks alternated forever). A mega rock (more than 80 chunks taken) waits a random 0-288 s more, Glitch's extra 0-16 min (include/mining.js 415-417) at 0.3 (PACED_WAITS rock_respawn_extra), in solo mining, help crews and the realtime server.
entries.ruling: Austin 2026-11-17 (G983): keep, mining at 0.3; the same pace for other timed systems is under consideration. Austin 2026-11-19 (#521): rocks reform in 480 s x 0.3 = 144 s. Austin 2026-11-19: a mega rock's extra 0-960 s at 0.3

entries.title: The street loading card stays up until its Home to: list has been visible its reading time (at least 2.5 s)
entries.why: #478: Glitch sent the Home to: list with the move start (NetController.as 1388-1395), so it was up for the whole load; the remake only knows what a street holds once it is built, so under Glitch's 200 ms hold (TSMainView.as 1766) the list was up for a blink. The card now holds 300 ms a word of the list (read-time.js READ_PER_WORD_MS), at least 2.5 s, at most 10 s; a card without a list keeps Glitch's timings.
entries.ruling: Austin 2026-11-18 (G993, calls P9iN1Q8WPs8rYTDVPGLfXp): hold the card until the list has been up its reading time (~2.5 s)

entries.title: Circle the spot: a report's picture can carry up to three red rings, drawn in its big view with a drag or a tap (or the keys), drawn into the JPEG that is sent and shown on its thumbnail, in the game in both skins and in the phone companion (#49).

entries.ruling: Austin 2026-11-22 (G796): move saves onto the originals; the Uralia pick is the lane's (Tiny Hominid), for Austin to confirm

entries.title: The house's Customize window keeps each change at once (Glitch previewed changes and asked Save Your Changes? on close)
entries.why: ChassisManager.as previewed the chassis and confirmed on close (cancelling_cdVO, and a credits confirm). With everything free the remake follows its Tower Customize, which also keeps each change.

entries.title: The Bureaucracy clerks sell Card-Carrying Qualifications to badge holders too (Glitch stopped once you held the badge)

entries.title: A work step you have no listed tool for names every tool it takes, and when you hold the kin tool it does not take, adds "Your Fancy Pick won't do: this step takes a Pick." (G1191).
entries.why: quest.js get_status 973 says only "You don't have a working <class_id>." and a step takes only the classes it lists (G1089), so players holding a Fancy Pick read the refusal as a bug. Glitch's sentence stays first and unchanged when no kin tool is held.

entries.title: Hell's Bartender's no-ticket lines (the talk line, the Buy refusal) are followed by his own "Ask a friend among the living to Mourn your death or Celebrate your life at your gravestone." (G1196).
entries.why: The words are Glitch's (hell_bartender.js yes_quest_no_ticket 763), but Glitch said them only in the first-visit conversations; the Buy refusal and the after-quest talk line just said a ticket was needed, so players who croaked expected a ticket for nothing (#505, #596).

entries.title: Online, the start card's Today panel shows the featured street project as this browser last saw it, with See the project (G1206).
entries.why: The start card and the featured project are both the remake's (G1081, G656); #568 asked for the project on the card, and the #576 reply promised it once the featured project was always reachable (R11, v0.54.1). The realtime session starts only after Start, so the card shows the last one seen, with its percent then.

entries.title: The Projects panel's Sort: Status (as before) or Region, which groups Open and Done by region A to Z under each region's name, kept in this browser (G1210).
entries.why: The Projects panel is the remake's (ticket 81); report #591 asked for All/Open/Done (built, G1116) and to sort projects by region.

entries.title: In the Modern pack row a full bag's bar takes the accent and its slot a mid grey backdrop, and its name reads ", full" to a screen reader (G656, G1193, G1214).
entries.why: Glitch's opener strip printed used/total (PackSlot.as 147-176), which Classic keeps; Modern draws it as a thin bar, so a full bag looked like a nearly full one. The accent bar shipped first (v0.33.0); the backdrop is the Ideas thread's next step that Austin's reply named, softened from navy to a mid grey token (--surface-bag-full) after #637.

entries.title: Decoration Mode's Set down puts what a Storage Display Box holds onto the floor beside it, not through the pack (Glitch's remove went only to the pack)
entries.why: bag_furniture_sdb.js remove 495-575 moved a box's things only into the pack. A player asked to move things between boxes and the floor without the pack (#384); floor to box already goes straight in (#473, stackIntoBox, as deposit 718-741 did), so this is the way back.

entries.title: Everyone on the street who hears a Peat Bog's call sees Peter out Peat's 9 second countdown, not only the quest holder
entries.why: In Glitch the 9 second timer was a buff on the quest holder alone (quests/bogspecialization_harvest_full_peat_bog_in_time_period.js 80, catalog_buffs.js 149-169), so helpers could not see it and groups missed the window by fractions of a second. Helpers now get the same Peter out Peat chip in their buff strip from the bog's call (bog_call, sent as the 9 s start); the holder keeps their own buff. The rules, the 9 s and the words stay Glitch's.
entries.ruling: Austin 2026-11-23 (G1187): show the Peter out Peat timer to everyone helping, a small departure from Glitch

entries.title: Tapping a hanging icicle on Winter Walk plays a chime (Tiny Speck's WM_E2 icicle note)
entries.why: The walk's caption (Glitch's own words, read off the Snaps) asks about the ding-a-ling-ling sound icicles make when you tap them, but the walk's template and scripts are lost, so how a tap sounded is unknown and tapping did nothing (#298). A click or a tap on one of the six big hanging icicles now plays WM_E2, the highest of the icicle notes Lotha Harte's tapped icicles play (Clickable Broadcasters, js/street-toys.js). It works from anywhere on the walk, never walks you under one, and the falls (G472) are unchanged.
entries.ruling: Austin 2026-11-23 (G1203): make tapping the icicles play a chime from Tiny Speck's sounds, without changing the falling icicles

entries.title: Animal names may hold an apostrophe, a hyphen and a period, beside Glitch's letters, numbers and spaces

Naming a Piggy, Chicken, Butterfly or Batterfly now also keeps ' - and . (a phone's curly apostrophe counts as the straight one), solo and online, and the live hint says so; the 32 characters stay Glitch's, a name still needs a letter or a number, and emoji and other scripts are still dropped. The realtime server cleans a street animal's name by the same rule (groddle-afternoon-server objects_pigs.go sanitizeAnimalName, widened with it).
entries.ruling: Austin 2026-11-23 (G1207): allow apostrophe, hyphen and period in animal names, a small departure from Glitch; 32 characters max stays

entries.title: For 30 days after a player changes their own name, their profile page and the /chat/ people lists show "formerly <old name>", and their old /players/ address answers a redirect to the new one (G1213, #636).

Austin's brief for the paid rename (1,000 currants, 30 days) asked for the old name to show for a while so friends can still find them. entries.title: Marylpole Mount Quarter, 1100 block: a shared street of free player lots, each showing its owner's home-street house and leading to their home street

Kept Glitch's: the '<Name> Quarter, <x><y>00 block' and '<x><y>## <Name> Quarter' names (groups/quarter.js), the QUARTER signpost (SignpostView.as), one house per player and none with an owner (pols_canBuy), the familiar's For Sale words, the For Sale sign. Ours: a lot is free (no currants, no papers), a front is the owner's G796 house leading to their home street through the G328 visit (no second house, no interior), giving a lot up puts it back on sale (Glitch sold back at 80%), the parent street and block number, solo shows only your own lot, and the claim and refusal lines where Glitch had none.
entries.ruling: Austin 2026-11-23 (G1186): option A, a new shared street of house lots, one meadow block of 10 to 12 lots; free, one lot per player, front to the home street, one quarter for everyone, solo own lot only (the note's defaults)

entries.title: Decoration Mode marks: at your own home online, a small lock pip on the stacks only you can pick up (on hover or tap, and on all of them in Decoration Mode) with the words "Only you can pick this up" beside it on the stack under the pointer, and an "Anyone here can pick this up" line in a dropped stack's menu header (Glitch showed the owner no difference)

entries.title: The walk-past chips: a key chip over the nearest thing in reach naming it, or "choose from N" with several, and the signpost and ladder chips ("Enter · Choose a road", "↑ climb"), shown as you walk past (phones only since #669 and G1310)

Austin 2026-11-25 evening (G1310): the signpost and ladder chips too, glow only, as Glitch: on a computer the post at hand glows (no chip while climbing or at a ladder either), Enter still takes hold of the post and Up still climbs; phones keep both chips

entries.title: Skills sheet: one line under an open skill saying its study takes longer because more skills are known than the brain holds
entries.why: A player asked why a skill took so long (#663, G1244). Glitch's slowdown is kept as it was (1.05 for each skill known or queued past brain capacity, skills_get_learning_time_modifier, inc_skills.js:1792); Glitch never said so on the skill. entries.ruling: Austin 2026-11-24 (#663): add one plain line on the Skills sheet explaining that skills past brain capacity slow study and Brain Capacity cards help.

entries.title: A sorted bag shows its sort: a small round badge with one item icon in the bag slot's top right corner (Modern), the icon in place of the count strip's dot (Classic), the sort's words in the tip, the tray head and the bag's label, and each sort's icon in the Sort menu

A player asked for an indicator, possibly symbols (Ideas board). Each badge is an existing item icon the sort takes; one-kind bags (Toolbox, Spice Rack, Alchemistry Kit, Cubimal Case, Elemental Pouch) get none.
entries.ruling: Austin 2026-11-24 (G1246, the Sorted Bag Badges design): Option A, the corner badge; no badge on one-kind bags; Staples A+B one icon; icons as designed; keep Glitch's Sort: Staples names; Sort menu icons in the same change; words back up the symbol; Classic draws it on the strip.

entries.title: Vine Radio: a home street radio, earned from the crabs, that plays the music of the places you have been for you and your visitors
entries.why: A player asked for a jukebox (#661, G1245). Glitch had no radio, jukebox or record player a player could own (glitch-GameServerJS items: none). Ours: the Tunes for Crabs quest (6 tunes, the 10-for-8 Austin asked scaled to the 5 crabs on the open world), the vine radio decoration (Tiny Speck, CC0, Ix set) stood on the home street in Cultivate, the Choose music sheet (regions by visiting, theme tracks by hearing them, musicblocks by owning them), street-only playback that is louder near the radio, and a visitor's opt-out. Only music the game already ships; the party's lively stand-in is left out. #705: the radio never goes in the pack, so a quest reward kind for an unlock (rewards.unlock) names it on the award card with its art and adds an Activity line saying it waits in Cultivate on your home street; it is not put out by itself.
entries.ruling: Austin 2026-11-24 (#661, G1245): build the Vine Radio, Option A (a Music Crab quest), street only, louder near the radio, region names, Classic as fits.

entries.title: Street Butterflies fly one way and come back in from the far end; Batterflies swing 170 px about their spot on an 18 s sine, off the street near an end

The wrap made one pop in at the street's edge every lap (Austin 2026-11-24: 'seeming to loop spawn').

entries.title: Street Butterflies fly 30-50 px/s and Batterflies 30-45 px/s

entries.title: Camera Mode's "Snap the whole house" (and "Snap the whole Tower", "Snap the whole street"): at your own home, a Snap of every floor stacked (or the whole home street) drawn off the camera, saved as an ordinary private Snap (Glitch's camera snapped only the view; its whole-home picture was the automatic saveHomeImg)

entries.ruling: Austin 2026-11-25 (report #669): "can we expand the snapshot feature to take a photo of the entire house like in Glitch?"; own home only until he rules on visitors

entries.ruling: Austin 2026-11-25 (lane camk, approved pending objection): solo snaps save to the device; same card rule as online; the house file practice copy can snap

entries.why: Glitch had no phone client: its Camera Mode snapped with Enter only (CameraMan.as onEnterKey 679-683), which a phone has no key for, so phone players could not snap.
entries.ruling: Austin 2026-11-25 (G1314): a Snap button in Camera Mode on phones

entries.title: Sound pauses when the page is hidden on a phone or tablet, with the setting "Keep playing sound in the background" (on by default on a computer, off on a phone or tablet)
entries.why: Glitch's Flash client kept playing when its window lost focus (StageBeacon.onDeactivate only throttled the frame rate; SoundMaster had no focus handling). Phones put the browser away, where music playing on was a report (#660).
entries.ruling: Austin 2026-11-25 (#693): keep sound playing in the background on a computer as Glitch did; pause on phones and tablets; a setting to choose

entries.title: A finished Group Hall's lot stays on its street with the owning group's name over the sign, and its words say the hall's street opens later
entries.why: No hall street survives in the archive (G331). Glitch hid the lot, named the hall after the group and opened a members-only signpost (quest.js 1831-1863); until hall streets exist, the lot and its words show whose hall it is.
entries.ruling: Austin 2026-11-25 (calls page, #696, G1301): show ownership now, hall streets next

entries.why: Glitch tested the wall gap from the player (pc.x) and let the drop land anywhere on the floor's plat line (HandOfDecorator.as checkXIsInBounds); checking where it lands keeps the art inside the walls.

entries.title: House and Tower buttons on the Map's home card, beside its Home button
entries.why: Player request (#722). Glitch's map had no home buttons, only the /home, /house and /tower chat commands (main.js doChatCommand); the home card itself is ours. The buttons run /house and /tower, with their own checks and travel; House shows once you have a home street, Tower once the Tower is built.
entries.ruling: Austin 2026-11-26 (report #722): add House and Tower beside Home on the Shortcuts' home card; House once you have a home street (follow-up the same day: not beside Get your home street), Tower once built; solo and online, Modern and Classic, phones

entries.title: Who's here's online count line, a link to the website's chat ("8 other players online. See who")
entries.why: Glitch's Local pane tip named only the people on the street (RightSideManager.as localTooltip); the count of players online in the game (the server's presence_count, ours-presence) is ours. The line opens /chat/ in a new tab, whose Who's around panel lists everyone online, so the game keeps running.
entries.ruling: Austin 2026-11-26 (#415 follow-up): make the online count line a link to /chat/ in a new tab; solo shows nothing new

entries.title: Koulato Cluster's wormhole to Ruta Asuncion: the box at the hidden ladder's top and the landing at Ruta Asuncion's entrance
entries.why: Glitch had this wormhole (LIF10RP1DBU11NU.xml lists Collision-triggered Teleporter IA9AM2L1AN42QFA; the glitch forum, 2012: climb the hidden ladder behind the pillar, jump to the right, sent to Ruta Asuncion; Glitch Strategy Quick Tip #16) but its instanceProps were never archived. Ours: the box (world x -1820..-1640, y -845..-1200, the foot of the steep slope right of the ladder top, where a jump to the right lands) and the landing (Ruta Asuncion world 1100, -195, the ground-floor arrival its Baby Steppes and Guillermo Gamera Way posts already use).
entries.ruling: Austin 2026-11-26 (report #710): wire it to Ruta Asuncion; Glitch's landing spot was not archived, so land players at Ruta Asuncion's entrance and mark the landing as ours

entries.title: A player's name keeps one colour in chat and in their bubbles, fixed by their player id
entries.why: Glitch gave each speaker the next chat_element_others_N colour in the order they first spoke that session (RightSideManager.as 803-822 getPCColorIndex), so a name's colour changed between sessions; the bubbles used the same colour (AvaChatBubbleManager.as 117-119). Ours: the colour comes from the player's stable id, so it is the same across days and devices; your own name stays Modern's violet.
entries.ruling: Austin 2026-11-26 (report #709): colour names in Modern chat and speech bubbles, one fixed colour per player keyed by id, Glitch's palette, your own violet

entries.title: The Stoot shrine's demon holds an empty frame with a blank plaque, where Glitch had a framed photo
entries.why: On unnnn (GIFPV9EMLT72DP4), Glitch's flash_crasher_demon held up rook_hall_placeholder_painting, a framed photo of a real person, which the remake does not ship (recover.py HELD), so the demon held nothing and players saw the shrine as broken. Ours: the same deco's own wooden frame from firebog.swf (Tiny Speck, CC0) with the photo and the plaque's words taken out (FFDec swf2xml edit), at the painting's placement (layer T_1311832165202, x 517, y 426, 375 x 284). No pixel of the photo is used.
entries.ruling: Austin 2026-11-25 (live chat about the Stoot shrine): keep the photo out, give the demon an empty frame, marked ours
entries.noCompare: The original is a photo of a real person, which the remake does not ship or show.

entries.title: Making spends the emptiest Firefly Jars first, so a full jar stays while an empty one could go
entries.why: A recipe that uses up Firefly Jars of any fill (the Fireplace takes 7, catalog_recipes.js 321) took them in bag order in Glitch (inc_making checkItemsInBag, items_destroy), so a jar of Fireflies could go while an empty one stayed. Ours: the empty jars go first, then the least full (ties: the later ones, as before); the kept jars keep their pack order. Solo and online make through the same code.
entries.ruling: Austin 2026-11-26 (report #720 follow-up): spend empty jars before full ones
